versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the upstage-studio skill.
- Run document processing workflows using Upstage Document Agent API (v2), supporting both Studio-UI-configured and API-defined agents/configs.
- Handles file upload, agent/config creation, job execution, and result polling.
- Supports multi-step workflows with parse → classify → extract chains.
- Includes comprehensive usage details, error handling, output file management, and helpful troubleshooting tips.
